{{Short description|Dutch logician (born 1947)}}
[[File:Henk Barendregt at the Old Jewish Cemetery in Prague.jpg|thumb|Henk Barendregt during his visit in Prague in April 2012]]
'''Hendrik Pieter (Henk) Barendregt''' (born 18 December 1947, [[Amsterdam]])<ref>{{cite book |editor1=Erik Barendsen |editor2=Herman Geuvers |editor3=Venanzio Capretta |editor4=Milad Niqui | title=Reflections on Type Theory, Lambda Calculus, and the Mind &mdash; Essays Dedicated to Henk Barendregt on the Occasion of his 60th Birthday | publisher=University Nijmegen | url=https://www.cs.ru.nl/barendregt60/essays | isbn=978-90-9022446-6 | year=2007 }} Here: [https://www.cs.ru.nl/barendregt60/essays/preliminary/prelims.pdf Preface], p.5</ref> is a Dutch [[Mathematical logic|logician]], known for his work in [[lambda calculus]] and [[type theory]].

== Life and work ==
Barendregt studied [[mathematical logic]] at [[Utrecht University]], obtaining his master's degree in 1968 and his PhD in 1971, both ''[[cum laude]]'', under [[Dirk van Dalen]] and [[Georg Kreisel]]. After a postdoctoral position at [[Stanford University]], he taught at [[Utrecht University]].

Since 1986, Barendregt has taught at [[Radboud University Nijmegen]], where he now holds the Chair of Foundations of Mathematics and Computer Science. His research group works on Constructive Interactive Mathematics. He is also adjunct professor at [[Carnegie Mellon University]], Pittsburgh, US. He has been a visiting scholar at [[Technische Universität Darmstadt|Darmstadt]], [[ETH Zürich]], Siena, and Kyoto.

Barendregt was elected a member of [[Academia Europaea]] in 1992.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Barendregt_Hendrik |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328092345/https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Barendregt_Hendrik |title=Hendrik Barendregt |publisher=Academia Europaea |archive-date=28 March 2019}}</ref> In 1997 Barendregt was elected member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3833 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200521080831/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3833 |title=Henk Barendregt |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |archive-date=21 May 2020}}</ref> On 6 February 2003 Barendregt was awarded the [[Spinozapremie]] for 2002, the highest scientific award in the Netherlands.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nwo.nl/en/research-and-results/programmes/spinoza+prize/spinoza+laureates/overview+by+year/2002 |title=NWO Spinoza Prize 2002 |publisher=Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research |date=5 September 2014 |access-date=30 January 2016 |archive-date=3 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303231851/http://www.nwo.nl/en/research-and-results/programmes/spinoza+prize/spinoza+laureates/overview+by+year/2002 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2002 he was knighted in the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion|Orde van de Nederlandse Leeuw]].

Barendregt received an honorary doctorate from [[Heriot-Watt University]] in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.hw.ac.uk/news/edinburgh-campus-graduations.htm|title = Edinburgh Campus graduations - News {{!}} Heriot-Watt University Edinburgh|website = www.hw.ac.uk|access-date = 2016-03-24}}</ref>
